subject: half the herd gone quiet
body: Half my herd's collars went quiet after the storm. Nothing showing on the map since early this morning for the ones near the {tower}. Can you check?

subject: Collars offline
body: Around {n} collars all dropped off at the same time about an hour or two ago. The cows are right there in front of me, collars on, lights on. Something wrong with the network?

subject: {farm} - no data
body: Hi it's {first} at {farm}. Using the wife's email as mine is playing up. Most of our collars haven't reported since yesterday. Is the tower down? The solar panel on it was covered in muck last time I looked.

subject: map frozen
body: Map's frozen for a big chunk of the mob. The ones on the other side of the farm are still moving about fine. Weird.

subject: still nothing
body: Still no positions from the cows by the {tower}, been nearly a day now. I need to know where the springers are. When will it be back?

subject: lots of collars not working
body: {collar}, {collar2} and a heap of others not working since this morning. All on the same side of the farm. Do I need to take them off?

subject: tower light off
body: Drove past the {tower} and the little light on the box is off. None of the collars round there are showing. Bad weather all week so maybe the battery?

subject: collar going flat
body: {collar} keeps going flat. Comes back in the morning then gone again at night. The others are all fine. Is it the cloud?

subject: Battery warnings every day
body: Getting a low battery warning on {collar} every single day for the last week. Is that collar on the way out?

subject: one cow keeps disappearing at night
body: Cow with collar {num} disappears off the app every night and pops back up after breakfast. Happened 4 nights in a row now.

subject: collar wont hold charge
body: This one wont hold charge anymore, {collar}. Panel is clean, I wiped it.

subject: battery dropping fast overnight
body: On {collar} the battery drops really fast overnight. Rest of the herd is sitting up in the 80s and 90s.

subject: old collar?
body: {collar} is one of our oldest and the battery seems shot. Dies most nights. Weather's been good.

subject: Is it the weather?
body: Been a few grey days and collar {num} is struggling, battery right down. Will it come right on its own?

subject: after the update
body: Ever since the update went through the batteries are dropping much quicker on a lot of the collars, {collar} for one. Anyone else had this?

subject: cows not showing up
body: Half the time the cows aren't showing where they are, the dots just sit there for hours. Started a few days ago across the whole herd.

subject: Battery and GPS both worse
body: Both the battery and the location seem worse since about Tuesday. {collar}, {collar2}, {collar3} are examples. Did you change something?

subject: whole herd batteries low
body: All my collars are draining faster this week. Sun's been out so I don't get it.

subject: version 3.5.0?
body: App says the collars are on 3.5.0 now. Since then the tracks have gaps all through them and batteries are lower. Coincidence?

subject: missing positions
body: Lots of missing positions on {collar} and others. Not the tower, the collars are still sending something.

subject: update problem
body: Neighbour says his collars went bad after the software update and mine are the same. Batteries and GPS. Is there a fix coming?

subject: collar stopped after creek
body: {collar} stopped working. That mob crossed the creek a couple of days ago, all the others are fine.

subject: weird temperature
body: App showed {collar} with a really high temperature for a day and now it's not reporting at all. Is the cow sick or the collar?

subject: one collar dead
body: Collar {num} is dead. Nothing since yesterday. Rest of the herd fine.

subject: fogged up inside
body: Took {collar} off the cow because it stopped. There's fog inside the little window on it. Is that water?

subject: collar not showing
body: {collar} was dropping in and out for a bit and now nothing. Lots of rain here lately.

subject: collar gone
body: Lost collar {num} off the map. Went out and found the cow, collar still on but doing nothing. They were in the swampy paddock.

subject: cow in neighbours paddock
body: App says the cow with {collar} is in the neighbour's paddock but she's in with the others, I can see her. Happened a few times this week.

subject: jumping around
body: {collar}'s dot jumps all over the place, the track looks like a scribble. The others look normal.

subject: location wrong
body: Location for collar {num} is wrong, out by a fair bit. Getting worse each day.

subject: Cow on the road
body: Got a call from a neighbour saying the app (I showed him) has my cow on the road. She's not. {collar}. Can you check it?

subject: accuracy
body: Accuracy on {collar} seems poor lately, its position wanders even when she's lying down.

subject: one collar all over the place
body: Only one of them, {num}, all over the place on the map. Battery looks fine on it.

subject: Collars dropping out
body: Collars keep dropping out on the hill block, then turning up again later. Are they faulty? {collar} is one of the worst.

subject: signal
body: Signal bars on most of my collars are always low. We're pretty hilly here. Is that normal or do I need new collars?

subject: positions late
body: Positions come in late and in bunches for the cows down the gully. {collar} and {collar2} especially. Batteries seem fine.

subject: better reception?
body: Is there anything we can do to get better reception behind the big ridge? The collars there go missing for an hour here and there.

subject: since install
body: Since we put the collars on, the ones in the back gullies have always been patchy. Just checking that's expected.

subject: batteries all down
body: All the collar batteries are down after the storm. Still showing up on the map though. Anything I need to do?

subject: low battery alerts across herd
body: Got low battery alerts for loads of collars today, after three days of rain. Collars are still working. Normal?

subject: solar
body: Hardly any sun all week and the collar batteries are lower than I've seen them. Will they come back up?

subject: Grey days
body: Run of grey days here and the charge on the collars is dropping. {collar} is at the bottom. Worth worrying about?

subject: battery levels
body: Battery levels down on pretty much every collar on {farm} after the weather. They're all reporting. Just want to check.

subject: collar loose
body: A few of the collars are hanging really loose on the heifers. How tight should they be?

subject: collar stuck in one spot
body: {collar} has shown in the same corner of the paddock for two days. Went to look and it was lying in the grass, the cow was nowhere near it.

subject: rubbing
body: Collar is rubbing the neck on one of the cows, {collar}. Should I loosen it?

subject: collar cracked
body: Cow got the collar caught in a gate and the case on {collar} has a big crack down the side. Strap's fine. Can I get it replaced?

subject: can't log in
body: Can't log in to the app, it says wrong password and the reset email never comes.

subject: add my son
body: How do I add my son to the farm account so he can see where the cows are?

subject: locked out
body: This is {first} from {farm}. The email on the account was my old work one and I can't get into it anymore so I can't reset the password. Locked out completely.

subject: invoice question
body: Where do I find last month's invoice? Accountant wants it.

subject: how many collars am I paying for
body: How is the number of collars on the bill worked out? We sold some cows mid month.

subject: overcharged
body: Bill says 120 collars, we only have 95 on. I want a refund for the difference, this is the second month.

subject: cancel
body: We're selling the farm at the end of the season. How do I cancel the subscription?

subject: new collars arrived
body: The 20 new collars turned up today. How do I get them into the app?

subject: moving mob
body: Want to move the dry cows to the back block. Do the collars need setting up again for a new paddock?

subject: pairing
body: How do you pair a collar? The QR code thing isn't obvious.

subject: too many alerts
body: Getting far too many notifications. How do I turn some off?

subject: alerts to manager
body: Can the alerts go to my farm manager's phone instead of mine?

subject: battery texts
body: Low battery texts at 3am are driving me mad. Can they come in the morning instead?
